bug_info.bug_desc: The high-to-low met pulse expression is inverted. The old code computes `h2l_met_pulse[k] = ~h2l_met_d & h2l_met_q`, which generates a pulse when the debounced high-to-low met signal deasserts (falling edge of `h2l_met_d`), rather than when the debounce condition is first satisfied (rising edge of `h2l_met_d`). As a result, valid H2L debounce completions do not produce `h2l_met_pulse`, so the corresponding interrupt status update and aggregated interrupt are not generated as specified.
bug_info.fix_hint: Change the H2L met pulse assignment to detect the rising edge of `h2l_met_d`, matching the L2H behavior: `assign h2l_met_pulse[k] = h2l_met_d & ~h2l_met_q;`. This ensures a one-cycle pulse is generated exactly when the H2L debounce condition becomes met.
